<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral oversight challenges:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued notices to the Election Commission regarding petitions from the INDIA bloc, while the Cockroach Janta Party’s protests over alleged voter irregularities have gained international attention from the diaspora in Berlin.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Voter roll reforms:</strong> The Election Commission has mandated a Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls across 17 states, requiring the publication of more readable versions to improve transparency.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial ruling on SC status:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that conversion to Islam results in the loss of Scheduled Caste status, a decision with significant implications for reservation policy and identity politics.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPYkRwd3Q0V0ZRTlZVenVCZU00NzVialZCX19LVjRNdXJOVTNGOU9ZRFdsSDNkTGJ2aGRyb1IzZ0tfYkVaSXFkOHBCaDVfTlhwdUNiSmVIRU9hUE9jeC1zNzlLQ3Yxb21rSG5MRXAtVmxVTG5YNm9uQlhWWTAxQ0xBVVE5UnZ2bG5tRm53ZTVxRlZsOW1UVi04Z3FFUVpJQlBW?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Railway infrastructure expansion:</strong> The Union Cabinet has approved three multitracking railway projects spanning 307 kilometers across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, and Jharkhand to enhance national connectivity.</li>
  <li><strong>Political strategy and allegations:</strong> BJP leadership has instructed party workers to counter opposition claims with factual data, even as opposition figures like Manish Sisodia allege that the BJP and Congress are colluding to use central agencies against political rivals.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
